messages:
Aisha (Partnerships): Quick one — launching the hands-on practice labs for SI onboarding next month. We need a mentor roster, proctoring windows (incl APAC-friendly times), and the verified lab exam flow for the new 'Integrator Verified' badge. Who can own scheduling?
Diego (SI enable): I can own schedule + mentor rota. need confirmation on infra access: will mentors use our sandbox VPC or partner HW in-market? also need a small checklist for mentor laptop image (ssh keys, docker, nvml).
Maya (PartnerEng): For marketplace labs, we'll use the Redwood sandbox cluster for the first run. For HW partner labs (edge appliances) we should coordinate with vendors to ship dev units to mentors or run remote access sessions. I can take point on vendor coordination.
Ben (SI-Ops): Heads up — for remote HW sessions we should require mentors to be on the vpn and have the KVM access token. Ops can generate temporary KMS keys scoped to lab sessions. Also, APAC mentors prefer 8-11pm PST slots — we should batch sessions.
Jules (Onboarding): Drafted a scoring rubric for the practical: pass/fail + points for reliability tests. I'll paste short rota template below. Also want to add a mandatory proctoring checklist.
Jules (Onboarding): ```
Week 1 (Apr 12-16): Mentor A (US morning), Mentor B (APAC evening)
Week 2 (Apr 19-23): Mentor C (EU afternoon), Mentor D (US morning)
Exam window: two 2-hour slots per day, Mon-Fri
Proctoring: live screen share + terminal recording (retained 30 days)
```
Diego (SI enable): That looks good. Can we reduce exam window to 90 mins for the CLI + deploy task? keeps sessions tight. Also need sample prompts/tasks that map to platform SLOs (latency under 200ms for hosted example, successful pipeline to Redwood Dedicated).
Maya (PartnerEng): I'll produce 4 lab tasks: 1) marketplace deploy + smoke test; 2) dedicated capacity config + load test; 3) on-prem install (basic) with limited HW; 4) integration with partner k8s ingress. Will include acceptance criteria.
Ben (SI-Ops): Logistics: request for hardware partner remote access — we'll need vendor contact + serial numbers for dev units. @Maya please share vendor list by EOD Friday so I can schedule KMS tokens.
onboarding-bot: Reminder — please add final mentor assignments to the onboarding calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/si-practice-labs (auto-created).
Aisha (Partnerships): Great stuff. Action items: Diego = mentor schedule + weekly rota (deliver by Tue); Maya = vendor lab tasks + vendor contacts (deliver by Fri); Jules = final rubric & proctor checklist (deliver by Tue); Ben = KMS/token plan + infra gating (confirm by Wed). If any conflicts with timing, call it out here. Otherwise we'll announce to SI partners next Monday. :thumbsup:
